# etcd-recipes

> Kotlin/Java/JVM client library for [etcd](https://etcd.io) v3, built on top of
> [jetcd](https://github.com/etcd-io/jetcd). Provides higher-level distributed
> coordination primitives — barriers, locks, leader election, queues, distributed
> counters, service discovery, key/prefix caches — analogous to what
> [Apache Curator](https://curator.apache.org) provides for ZooKeeper.

The library is a thin Kotlin extension layer over jetcd, not a wrapper. New recipes
compose the `common/` extensions (`ClientExtensions`, `KVExtensions`, `LeaseExtensions`,
`WatchExtensions`, `TxnExtensions`, `ByteSequenceExtensions`) rather than reaching into
jetcd directly. Stateful recipes extend `EtcdConnector` (in `common/`), which owns the
jetcd `Client`, tracks `startCalled` / `closeCalled`, derives a `connectionState`, and
routes background-thread failures to a single sink the caller can poll (`exceptions`) or
subscribe to (`BackgroundExceptionListener`) rather than throwing from a worker thread.

The blocking API is the primary, Java-usable surface. A Kotlin-first coroutine surface
(`io.etcd.recipes.coroutines`) sits alongside it: suspending twins of every blocking
entry point plus `Flow` versions of the watch and listener streams. Nothing in the
blocking API was changed to add it.

JDK 17+ runtime. Compiler-wide opt-ins for `kotlin.time.ExperimentalTime`,
`kotlin.ExperimentalUnsignedTypes`, and `kotlin.concurrent.atomics.ExperimentalAtomicApi`.

## Recipes

- `io.etcd.recipes.barrier` — `DistributedBarrier`, `DistributedBarrierWithCount`, `DistributedDoubleBarrier`
- `io.etcd.recipes.cache` — `PathChildrenCache` (key-prefix cache with PUT/UPDATE/DELETE listeners), `NodeCache<T>` (single-key cache), `TypedPathChildrenCache<T>`
- `io.etcd.recipes.counter` — `DistributedAtomicLong`
- `io.etcd.recipes.discovery` — `ServiceDiscovery`, `ServiceCache`, `ServiceInstance`, `ServiceProvider` with pluggable `ProviderStrategy` (random / round-robin / sticky) and error-ejection
- `io.etcd.recipes.election` — `LeaderSelector` (callback-scoped), `LeaderLatch` (holds leadership until `close()`), `LeaderObserver` (no candidacy), `Participant`
- `io.etcd.recipes.keyvalue` — `TransientKeyValue` (lease-backed key/value), `TypedTransientKeyValue<T>`
- `io.etcd.recipes.lock` — `DistributedMutex` (etcd's native lock service), `DistributedReadWriteLock` (fair shared/exclusive), `DistributedSemaphore` (counting)
- `io.etcd.recipes.queue` — `DistributedQueue`, `DistributedPriorityQueue` (at-most-once, with `poll`/`tryDequeue`/`enqueueAll`), `DistributedWorkQueue` (at-least-once: claim/ack, visibility timeout, dead-lettering, delayed delivery)
- `io.etcd.recipes.common` — Kotlin extensions over jetcd `Client`/`KV`/`Lease`/`Watch`/`Txn`; `EtcdCodec<T>` typed values; `ResilienceConfig`; `EtcdMetrics`
- `io.etcd.recipes.coroutines` — suspending twins (`awaitPutValue`, `receive`, `withLock`, …) and `Flow` surfaces (`watchAsFlow`, `eventsAsFlow`, `leadershipAsFlow`, …)

## Cross-cutting

- **Resilience** (on by default) — watchers auto-resubscribe after fatal stream deaths and re-anchor after compaction; leases self-heal and re-run the recipe's establish hook; blocking RPCs are bounded by an operation timeout and retry retriable statuses. Tuned per recipe via a trailing `ResilienceConfig`; `ResilienceConfig.DISABLED` restores pre-0.12 behavior. A lost *leadership* lease is deliberately never healed — the leader steps down.
- **Observability** — `EtcdMetrics`, a dependency-free SPI installed with `ResilienceConfig.withMetrics(...)` (RPC, watch-recovery, keep-alive, lock wait/hold, leadership transitions, queue, cache sync); push/pull background-exception channels; `isHealthy()` / `ping()`; recipe identity in the SLF4J MDC under `etcd.recipe`.
- **Typed values** — `EtcdCodec<T>` (`ByteSequenceCodec`, `StringCodec`, `jsonCodec<T>()`, or `JacksonCodec<T>`) types the KV extensions and every `Typed*` recipe, replacing hand-marshalled `ByteSequence`s.

## Modules

Published to Maven Central under the group `com.pambrose`. The core artifact was renamed
`etcd-recipes` → `etcd-recipes-core` in 0.12.0.

- `etcd-recipes-core` — the library; no dependencies beyond jetcd, coroutines, and logging
- `etcd-recipes-jackson` — `JacksonCodec<T>` for projects using Jackson
- `etcd-recipes-micrometer` — `MicrometerEtcdMetrics` backend plus `EtcdGauges` binders
- `etcd-recipes-spring-boot-starter` — auto-configured `Client` / `EtcdRecipes` beans from `etcd.recipes.*` properties, optional Actuator health indicator
- `etcd-recipes-ktor` — Ktor `Application` plugin exposing `application.etcdClient` / `etcdRecipes`

## Examples

Every recipe has runnable `main()` demos under `etcd-recipes-examples/` in both
[Kotlin](etcd-recipes-examples/src/main/kotlin/io/etcd/recipes/examples/) and
[Java](etcd-recipes-examples/src/main/java/io/etcd/recipes/examples/).

The documentation site's code examples are separate: real source files under
`src/test/.../website/` source sets, embedded into the Markdown at build time and
type-checked by `./gradlew compileTestKotlin compileTestJava`.

## Testing

- `make tests` — thread-based tests against a local etcd at `localhost:2379`
  (`./etcd-start.sh` or `make etcd-start` starts one)
- `make tests-tc` — same suite against a Testcontainers-managed etcd (no local etcd needed)
- `make tests-container` — multi-container variant: each participant runs in its own
  container coordinating through a shared etcd container
- Fault-injection tests (`io.etcd.recipes.fault`) pause / restart the etcd container to
  exercise watch recovery and lease healing; gated behind `-PuseTestcontainers`
